_notes.targetFps: Optional per-camera key. Add lane_config.cameras[].targetFps to set per-stream target FPS. If omitted, stream density falls back to global TARGET_FPS.

_about.name: Self-checkout lane, detect and classify
_about.summary: Simulates a self-checkout shopping lane that detects objects in the scene and then classifies what each one is
_about.cameras: One overhead lane camera at 15 fps
_about.why_run_it: Establishes how many detect-and-classify lanes a single system can drive, to compare against the detection-only baseline
